groups.defect: The second downsize definition overrides the width/height signature, leaving the first definition dead and breaking existing callers.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same method redefinition and resulting signature incompatibility. Differences in the described exception or affected caller do not change the underlying defect.

groups.defect: The flat 10MB client limit ignores attachment settings, accepts images that may remain oversized after five reductions, and advertises a maximum inconsistent with server limits in validation and 413 errors.
groups.rationale: All three report the attachment-limit mismatch introduced by the same client check. The merged comment must also preserve the insufficient-image-reduction case from s_7b3553a9 and the error-message problem, including the 413 handler, from s_ee27a71c.

groups.defect: The 10MB upload ceiling is repeated as a magic number in the controller and JavaScript utilities instead of using named constants or configuration.
groups.rationale: Both explicitly report the same repeated magic-number practice, with each file requiring an edit. This differs from the behavioral defect of ignoring per-type upload limits.

groups.defect: Values flow through direct interpolation into the shell command executed by convert_with, creating a command-injection surface.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same shell-command construction and execution path. Their differing characterization of whether the risk is new or pre-existing does not distinguish the reported defect.
